headline: Anthropic's Claude watermarking approach sparks debate over text integrity
body: Anthropic is embedding watermarks into Claude-generated text, a technique drawing criticism for altering output fidelity. For healthcare AI applications, this matters significantly: clinical documentation, EHR integration, and regulatory compliance all depend on text accuracy and traceability. Watermarking could complicate downstream processing in clinical workflows where exact character matching affects data integrity checks and audit trails. Healthcare organizations evaluating Claude for documentation assistance or clinical decision support need clarity on how watermarking impacts their EHR systems and compliance requirements around unaltered medical records.
